n1ab341c55a4.s: Which PM-AASHA component was the 2018 pilot in which private agencies procured oilseeds at MSP?
n1ab341c55a4.x: PPSS was the 2018 private-procurement pilot; PSS involves physical procurement by government agencies and PDPS only pays the price deficiency.

nindian-economy-6-3.s: MSP-based procurement helps build food stocks mainly for:
nindian-economy-6-3.x: MSP procurement builds the grain stocks used for the Public Distribution System, which links it to food security.

na2ad8e0b446.s: The Commission for Agricultural Costs and Prices (CACP) is:
o: A statutory body under an Act of Parliament
An attached office of the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
An attached office of the Ministry of Consumer Affairs
na2ad8e0b446.x: CACP is an attached office of the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare; it is not a statutory body.

n3beba97d82e.s: Besides the 22 mandated MSP crops, which crop receives a Fair and Remunerative Price (FRP)?
n3beba97d82e.x: Sugarcane receives FRP in addition to the 22 mandated MSP crops, making 23 in all; jute, copra and cotton are among the 22.

naa6c967d75c.s: The State Advised Price (SAP) of sugarcane is announced by:
naa6c967d75c.x: SAP is announced by certain States such as UP, Punjab and Haryana, usually above FRP; it is not fixed by the CACP.

nbeca423ff50.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about procurement at MSP?
o: Pulses, oilseeds and copra are procured under PSS with a 25% cap
Cotton is procured through the Cotton Corporation of India
Coarse grains are procured exclusively by the FCI
Wheat and paddy procurement is effectively open-ended
nbeca423ff50.x: Coarse grains are procured by State agencies, not exclusively by the FCI; the other three statements are correct.

n6bd3c489395.s: In Andhra Pradesh, paddy is bought from farmers at MSP mainly through:
n6bd3c489395.x: DCMS societies procure paddy at MSP in Andhra Pradesh, with APMARKFED as the apex cooperative marketing body.

nb1b32ac063e.s: Which of the following is NOT an objective of food management in India?
nb1b32ac063e.x: Food management covers procurement, storage and movement, public distribution and buffer stocks; export of foodgrains is not an objective.

n62dded056ef.s: Target-based PSS procurement of pulses and oilseeds is capped at what share of production?
n62dded056ef.x: PSS procurement of pulses and oilseeds is target-based with a 25 per cent cap, unlike open-ended wheat and paddy procurement.

nd8324e0475f.s: Free foodgrains to over 80 crore NFSA beneficiaries under the extended PMGKAY (from 1 January 2023) are provided up to:
nd8324e0475f.x: The free foodgrain arrangement began on 1 January 2023 and was extended for five years up to 31 December 2028.

n81d214d7890.s: Regulation of markets in agricultural products in India falls under:
o: The Department of Food and Public Distribution
n81d214d7890.x: Market regulation is done under State APMC laws; it is not an FCI function or mission.

nef4543f026e.s: Which of the following pairs related to Andhra Pradesh's Mee Mart is correctly matched?
o: Aim – door delivery by MDU vehicles
nef4543f026e.x: Mee Mart is run by the AP Civil Supplies Department with NCCF to turn Fair Price Shops into mini-marts; its first outlet is at Lalupuram near Guntur.

n8038bc90f0d.s: Open defecation and unsafe water contribute to malnutrition mainly through:
n8038bc90f0d.x: Unsafe water and open defecation cause disease-linked nutrient loss, which is how they contribute to malnutrition.

n85800586a21.s: Phase II (2022-23) of fortified rice distribution extended coverage under TPDS to how many Aspirational and high-burden districts?
n85800586a21.x: Phase II in 2022-23 covered 291 Aspirational and high-burden districts; Phase I covered ICDS and PM POSHAN and Phase III all TPDS districts.

new.s: The MSP for wheat for Rabi Marketing Season 2026-27 is:
new.x: Wheat MSP for RMS 2026-27 is ₹2,585 per quintal, up ₹160 from ₹2,425 in 2025-26.

new.s: The MSP for common paddy for Kharif 2026-27 is:
new.x: Common paddy MSP for 2026-27 is ₹2,441 per quintal (up ₹72); ₹2,461 is Grade A and ₹2,369 was the 2025-26 MSP.

new.s: Which kharif crop has the highest MSP for 2026-27?
new.x: Sesamum has the highest MSP at ₹10,346 per quintal; sunflower got the biggest hike (₹622).

new.s: The Statutory Minimum Price (SMP) of sugarcane was replaced by the Fair and Remunerative Price (FRP) from:
new.x: FRP replaced SMP from 2009-10, after the Sugarcane (Control) Order was amended on 22.10.2009.

new.s: Besides the Chairman, the CACP consists of:
o: A Member Secretary and four official members
Two official and two non-official members
A Member Secretary, one official member and two non-official members
A Member Secretary, two official members and one non-official member
new.x: The CACP has a Chairman, a Member Secretary, one official member and two non-official members.

new.s: Because of the regional bias in MSP procurement, farmers of which region gain little?
new.x: Procurement is concentrated in Punjab, Haryana, Telangana, AP and Chhattisgarh, so eastern and North-Eastern farmers gain little.

new.s: The Swaminathan Commission (NCF) recommended MSP at:
new.x: The Swaminathan Commission (2004-06) recommended MSP at C2 + 50%; present policy uses 1.5 times A2+FL instead.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about cost concepts in MSP:
1. A2 covers actual paid-out costs.
2. C2 excludes rent on owned land.
3. Present MSP is at least 1.5 times A2+FL.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: A2 is actual paid-out cost and MSP is at least 1.5 times A2+FL; statement 2 is wrong because C2 includes land rent and interest on fixed capital.

new.s: Under the WTO Agreement on Agriculture, the de minimis limit on amber-box support for developing countries is what share of production value?
new.x: Developing countries may give amber-box support up to 10% of production value; the limit for developed countries is 5%.

new.s: The 'peace clause' protecting public stockholding for food security was agreed at the WTO meeting in:
new.x: The peace clause agreed at Bali in 2013 protects public stockholding programmes for food security.

new.s: Which of the following is a hallmark of the post-1991 phase of Indian agricultural development?
o: Setting up of the APC and FCI
new.x: The post-1991 phase brought liberalisation, WTO (1995), e-NAM, FPOs and PM-KISAN; HYVs and APC/FCI belong to the Green Revolution phase.

new.s: Economists wary of a legal MSP guarantee generally prefer:
o: Higher procurement in Punjab and Haryana
new.x: Economists fear trade distortion, monoculture and WTO problems from a legal MSP and prefer PDPS-type payments of the price gap.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about PM-AASHA?
o: Under PDPS, agencies physically procure the produce
Under PSS, NAFED and NCCF procure pulses and oilseeds
new.x: PDPS pays the gap between MSP and market price without buying any produce; physical procurement happens under PSS.

new.s: Buffer stock norms for the Central Pool are fixed by the CCEA for each quarter as on:
new.x: Buffer norms are fixed quarterly by the CCEA as on 1 April, 1 July, 1 October and 1 January.

new.s: The strategic reserve of foodgrains held over and above the buffer norms comprises:
new.x: The strategic reserve is 30 LMT wheat (from 1.7.2008) and 20 LMT rice (from 1.1.2009).

new.s: The Central Pool buffer norm as on 1 April is:
new.x: The 1 April norm is 210.40 LMT, made up of 135.80 LMT rice and 74.60 LMT wheat.

new.s: Central Pool stocks of 604.02 LMT on 1 April 2026 were nearly how many times the buffer norm?
new.x: 604.02 LMT was nearly three times the 1 April norm of 210.40 LMT, raising carrying costs.

new.s: The food subsidy allocation in the Union Budget 2026-27 is about:
new.x: Union Budget 2026-27 provides ₹2,27,629 crore for food subsidy; ₹2,72,501.70 crore was the 2022-23 total and ₹1,99,500 crore the 2024-25 total.

new.s: Using NSS 2011-12 data, the Shanta Kumar High Level Committee estimated PDS leakage at about:
new.x: The Shanta Kumar Committee put PDS leakage at about 46% on the basis of NSS 2011-12 data.

new.s: The End-to-End Computerisation of TPDS operations scheme ran from:
new.x: End-to-End Computerisation ran from October 2012 to March 2020; SMART-PDS ran April 2023 to March 2026 and SARTHAK-PDS covers 2026-31.

new.s: The Targeted Public Distribution System (TPDS) was launched in:
new.x: TPDS began in June 1997 with BPL and APL entitlements; RPDS came in 1992 and AAY in December 2000.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about food procurement and distribution:
1. TPDS and Decentralised Procurement were both introduced in 1997.
2. The Revamped PDS was launched in 1992.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: DCP and TPDS both began in 1997, and RPDS was launched in June 1992.

new.s: Food subsidy is calculated as:
o: Economic cost minus Central Issue Price
Central Issue Price minus procurement incidentals
new.x: Food subsidy equals the economic cost of grain minus the Central Issue Price at which it is issued to States.

new.s: As per APSES 2024-25, Andhra Pradesh has about how many Fair Price Shops?
new.x: Andhra Pradesh has 29,796 Fair Price Shops serving 1.48 crore beneficiaries; 9,260 was the number of MDU vehicles.

new.s: After restoring Fair Price Shop distribution from 1 June 2025, Andhra Pradesh kept door delivery of rations only for:
new.x: AP ended MDU door delivery from 1 June 2025 and kept it only for people above 65 and the disabled.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh has about how many rice cards, all Aadhaar-seeded?
new.x: AP has 1.44 crore rice cards with 100% Aadhaar seeding.

new.s: In the Global Hunger Index 2025, India was ranked out of 123 countries at:
new.x: India ranked 102nd of 123 in GHI 2025 with a score of 25.8; it was 105th in 2024.

new.s: India's GHI 2025 score of 25.8 places it in which category?
new.x: A score of 25.8 puts India in the 'serious' category of the Global Hunger Index 2025.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT an indicator of the Global Hunger Index?
new.x: GHI uses undernourishment, child stunting, child wasting and child mortality; adult obesity is not an indicator.

new.s: According to FAO's SOFI 2025, the share of undernourished people in India is:
new.x: SOFI 2025 puts India's undernourished share at 12.0%; 25.8 is India's GHI score, not a share.

new.s: As per NFHS-5, anaemia among children under 5 years in India was about:
new.x: NFHS-5 found about 67% of under-5 children anaemic, up from 58.6%; about 57% of women were anaemic.

new.s: As per NFHS-5, stunting among children under 5 in Andhra Pradesh was:
new.x: AP's NFHS-5 stunting was 31.2%; 16.1% was wasting and 29.6% underweight.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about NFHS-6 (2026) compared with NFHS-5 for young children:
1. Severe wasting fell from 7.7% to 5.2%.
2. Complementary feeding at 6-8 months fell from 59.5% to 45.9%.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Severe wasting fell from 7.7% to 5.2%; complementary feeding rose, not fell, from 45.9% to 59.5%.

new.s: Wasting, measured as low weight-for-height, indicates which type of malnutrition?
new.x: Wasting (low weight-for-height) is acute malnutrition; stunting is chronic and underweight is composite.

new.s: PM POSHAN covers children of:
new.x: PM POSHAN covers Bal Vatika and classes I-VIII in government and aided schools.

new.s: The material (cooking) cost under PM POSHAN for Bal Vatika and primary classes was raised to how much per child per day?
new.x: The material cost was raised to ₹6.78 per child per day from ₹6.19 in 2025.

new.s: The Centre-State sharing ratio of PM POSHAN for non-NER States and UTs is:
new.x: PM POSHAN is shared 60:40 between the Centre and non-NER States and UTs.

new.s: Jagananna Gorumudda, Andhra Pradesh's school meal scheme, was renamed in July 2024 as:
new.x: Jagananna Gorumudda (January 2020) was renamed Dokka Seethamma Madhyahana Badi Bojanam in July 2024.

new.s: Bala Sanjeevani, the take-home ration scheme for AP's plain areas, was earlier known as:
new.x: Bala Sanjeevani was earlier YSR Sampoorna Poshana; YSR Sampoorna Poshana Plus was the tribal-area package.

new.s: Under Saksham Anganwadi and Poshan 2.0 (2021-22 to 2025-26), how many Saksham Anganwadi Centres are to be developed?
new.x: Two lakh Saksham AWCs are to be developed at 40,000 a year; 4.35 lakh is the number of Poshan Vatikas.

new.s: As per the Poshan Tracker (July 2025), which State has the highest share of child wasting?
new.x: Bihar leads in wasting (9.3%), followed by MP (8.1%) and Chhattisgarh (7.7%); UP leads in stunting.
